works.title: The Truth of Our Faith, Vol. 1
works.subtitle: Discourses from Holy Scripture on the Tenets of Christian Orthodoxy
works.author: Elder Cleopa of Romania
works.blurb: Elder Cleopa answers the questions of believers and the heterodox, grounding each reply in Holy Scripture and the Fathers. A warm, conversational catechism on the Orthodox faith from one of the great Romanian elders of the twentieth century.

works.title: The Truth of Our Faith, Vol. 2
works.subtitle: On the Christian Mysteries
works.author: Elder Cleopa of Romania
works.blurb: The second volume continues Elder Cleopa's scriptural discourses, turning to the holy mysteries (sacraments) of the Church and the life of grace they convey.
